description: Mounted on the roof of a house that operates as a guesthouse; previously displayed at the Kissa Avion cafe in Kanagawa
Displayed in USAF markings as 12834 with the fuselage code FU-834; the blog records the airframe as ex 12-7996 and previously as 02-7946; formerly at the Old Car Center Kudan in Fukushima
In a field plot with the OH-6J
In the field plot; the blog withholds the exact coordinate
Nose section only; believed rebuilt from parts of a scrapped airframe
The cockpit radio call reads 52-00XX which does not match the recorded identity

A hybrid: the fuselage is ex-JGSDF 51803 recovered from a scrap dealer and the rotor head is from a JASDF KV-107; the digits 03 on the fuselage show grinding marks. The original 51803 was displayed at Ibaraki Flower Park until it was broken up between 2009 and early 2010
A JMSDF S-62 sliding door held in a shed beside the V-107; confirmed present August 2026; recorded as a component not an airframe
